description: The seed that plants seeds. The double-diamond × safe-prereg discipline that births a new coltrane-flavored project. Dispatched once when a new repo is forked from coltrane-oss; the standard's verdict is the project's first sealed pre-reg.

phases.name: discover
phases.intent: Diverge. Survey the problem space. Scan cwd for use-case hints (package.json / pyproject.toml / .git history / README). Ask the user 'what kind of project?' if not inferable. Output a domain-survey artifact naming the candidate use-cases + their tensions. Refuses premature convergence.

phases.name: define
phases.intent: Converge. From the domain-survey, name the falsifiable: what is this project for, what would falsify it, what is it explicitly NOT. Emit a project-charter (kind=research-experiment | code-change | ops-readiness | idea-exploration | mixed). The SEAL fires at the discover→define seam — sha256_pre_verdict computed over {predict, kill, apoha}. This IS the project's birth pre-reg.

phases.name: develop
phases.intent: Generate the files. Under the sealed charter: write .coltrane/agents/, .coltrane/standards/, .coltrane/skills/, .coltrane/types/, .claude/agents/ (compiled view), .claude/commands/ (first-class slash commands), CLAUDE.md, tests/e2e/preseed/ specs, tonight/ substrate, README.md, and the project's first scaffold-prereg in the ledger. All sealed-fields of the charter are now FROZEN; appendable post-seal.

phases.name: deliver
phases.intent: Ripen + verdict. git init the project, first commit, run the preseed e2e specs to confirm the fleet's behavior matches charter, ripen the birth pre-reg (RIPENED / PARTLY-RIPENED / RIPENED-DIFFERENTLY / KILL-FIRED / ABORTED), and chime a tight welcome to the project owner. The verdict is the deliverable.

seams_with_seal: define -> develop (sealed charter is FROZEN; only observation appendable)
develop -> deliver (deliverables sealed; verdict scope frozen)

safe_prereg_discipline.default: DEFINE phase auto-creates a project-charter artifact; user marks PR ready-for-review OR runs `coltrane-seal` to fire the seal. If user skips seal, DEVELOP runs anyway and the recorder emits WARN: 'running without sealed charter — this is observation, not verification'. DELIVER computes verdict if seal exists; otherwise the artifact says 'unverified' (not 'failed').
safe_prereg_discipline.opt_in_tightening: Hard-gate seals (require sealed charter before DEVELOP can begin) is opt-in via project-charter.seal_required = true.
